ceremony.name: Rooms: an open room offered by the community, joined, written to and uploaded to, with the member's agent as key holder (wallet, community, agent)
ceremony.choreography: docs/32-rooms-ballot-ceremonies.md sections 3 to 5: offers, accept, memberships, a write, an upload, the refusals (replay, versionConflict, expired, wrong recipient, not a member, outsider, invalid manifest, not invited, type not actable, issuer not a principal) and two version step-downs. Open tier only.
